    - Kenwyn. I salvage. Iron and good old timber, out of the old wreck in the caves. Or I did. What can I do for you?
        - *Choice:* Take the salvagers' short way to the Captain's Cabin.
        - *Choice:* What is down there?
        - *Choice:* Why did you stop going in?

    - There's a way I never told anyone. Down the old rope, along the cave wall at low water, in through the stern windows. Straight into the cabin.
    - Hold on tight. And if it gets hold of you, let go of everything else.
    - The Bellcaves, under the south cliff. They boom like a bell when the tide's in, hence the name. And in the deepest of them, the Saltgrace.
    - A great trading ship from the harbour's early days. A storm drove her into the caves long ago and she wedged there, tilted, decks sloping down into the dark water. I've worked her for years.
    - This spring I went down the steps and she was crawling. Crabs in the holds, eels in the hatches, things I'd not seen in twenty years of salvage.
    - I came out the way I went in, with all my fingers. I'm not daft. I sit at the top of the steps now and draw maps for braver folk.
